subject: combined analysis of point-level and area-level data using SPDE

messages.author: ccb4b7b6d0dca264
messages.subject: combined analysis of point-level and area-level data using SPDE
parts:
Hi,

I would like to fit the model in spde, but I have some data that are on areal-level (cancer data) and some of them are in point-level (pollution data).
Is it good to use SPDE model in that case, and is there any similar research in that field that you could recommend me.

Thanks!

messages.author: 4cba9f1eaa634db3
messages.subject: Re: combined analysis of point-level and area-level data using SPDE
parts:
Depending on exactly what your data look like you might be interested in:

This paper fits areal and point data. It uses INLA and then switches to TMB for later models.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30202860/

My paper here where we use areal and point data on different scales (prevalence and incidence) using TMB. Also the references in the intro might be useful.
https://rss.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/rssc.12484

Sorry for the self-plug.

Tim
